messages.author: 9676a88bcd2419b9
messages.subject: DT - Warning in renderFunc
parts:
My app has several datatables created as shown below.  I now get the following warnings

Warning in renderFunc() :
  The render function should take at least two arguments (`name` and `shinysession`.

==============================================
both from github: DT_0.1.55, shiny_0.13.2.9003
==============================================


require(shiny)

ui <- navbarPage("Test",
    tabPanel("Input", 
        tabsetPanel("VarX", type="pills",
            tabPanel("File",
                fluidRow(
                    column(offset=1, width=2,
                        br(),
                        h5(em("Record Counts")),
                        DT::dataTableOutput(outputId="recordCount")
                    )
                )  
            )
        )
    )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

    output$recordCount <- DT::renderDataTable({
        tbl.dt <- data.frame("Name"=c("Variable","Primary","Comparison","Model Matrix"), "Count"=c(1,2,3,4))
        DT::datatable(tbl.dt, options=list(lengthChange=FALSE, paging=FALSE, searching=FALSE, ordering=FALSE, info=FALSE,
            columnDefs=list(list(width='60%', targets=0),list(className='dt-right', targets=1))), rownames=FALSE, #colnames=cnames, 
            class = 'nowrap stripe compact', selection='none')

    }, server=FALSE)
}


shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)

messages.author: 9676a88bcd2419b9
messages.subject: Re: DT - Warning in renderFunc
parts:
FYI -- this warning is showing up even for the examples on this page: https://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html

library(shiny)
shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(DT::dataTableOutput('tbl')),
  server = function(input, output) {
    output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable(
      iris, options = list(lengthChange = FALSE)
    )
  }
)

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT - Warning in renderFunc
parts:
Thanks for the report! I can reproduce it with the latest development
version of shiny.

Joe/Barbara: this is due to
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/commit/7eb29586a Basically
htmlwidgets::shinyRenderWidget() returns a rendering function with no
arguments, hence the warning from shiny:
https://github.com/ramnathv/htmlwidgets/blob/34d9cd02/R/htmlwidgets.R#L367-L398

Regards,
Yihui
